Format: each example is Name and Tags lines, a blank line, then the post body up to a line of %%%.
Format: Tags lists the labels the post gives its thread, in order; empty means none.
Format: ThreadLabelsTest (PHP) and HashtagTagsTest (public/assets/hashtag_tags.js) both read this file.
%%%
Name: hashtag-only last line
Tags: issue meta

Please add a gallery view.

#issue #meta
%%%
Name: hashtag-only line at the top
Tags: question

#question
What is this picture?
%%%
Name: run of hashtags ending the last line
Tags: meta

All should open an image gallery view #meta
%%%
Name: mentions in prose are references
Tags: issue meta

This put a task in the strip (#zen and #meme).

#issue #meta
%%%
Name: hashtag inside a sentence only
Tags:

I like #zen posts a lot.
%%%
Name: hashtag ending an earlier line
Tags:

This line ends with #zen
and this one does not.
%%%
Name: inline code
Tags:

Write `#meta` to tag a thread.
`#bug`
%%%
Name: fenced code
Tags:

```
#include <stdio.h>
#meta
```
%%%
Name: hashtag inside a URL
Tags:

See https://zenmemes.com/threads/x#meta
%%%
Name: Markdown link text
Tags:

[#zen](https://zenmemes.com/tags/zen)
%%%
Name: quoted lines
Tags:

> #zen #meme
I agree.
> #meta
%%%
Name: all-digit hashtags
Tags: meta

#1 #2024 #meta
%%%
Name: colour-like hashtags
Tags: bad1 meta

#fff #c0ffee #bad #bad1 #meta
%%%
Name: invalid label is text
Tags: meta

#Bug #meta
%%%
Name: punctuation after the last hashtag
Tags:

Thanks #meta.
%%%
Name: order and duplicates
Tags: ux bug a-b

#ux #bug
Some text.
#bug #a-b
%%%
Name: tag-only reply
Tags: prompt

#prompt
%%%
Name: trailing blank lines
Tags: meta

Text #meta


%%%
Name: comma between hashtags
Tags: ux

#bug, #ux
%%%
Name: image post with closing hashtags
Tags: meta

users page needs redesign, not easy to scan #meta

Image-v1: f3101611b91901491c0d430b7fcd04492bd521980cb5a9a29a7b4ac4ac524af9 png 54182 747 1012
Photo-Camera: Pixel 8
%%%

Tags:

I like #zen posts.
